data.title: Coimmunoprecipitation and following mass spectrometry analysis of EhRacM
data.projectDescription:
To find out the binding partners of EhRacM, crosslinking and coimmunoprecipitation were performed. Then, eluted samples were submitted to Mass Spectrometry and Proteomics Core Facility, Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine and analyzed by mass spctrometry (shotgun proteomics). The coimmunoprecipitation and following analysis were conducted three times.

You can find the data of HA-EhRacM (1st) from "2022_7_32_54_PM_FileSize_500998639_Byte_F010303.mzid.gz", "2022_7_32_54_PM_FileSize_500998639_Byte_F010303.mzid_2022_7_32_54_PM_File_Size__500998639__Byte__F010303.MGF", "RO-CS-LE_220912_NozakiT_MS_Rac16_WT.mzML", and "RO-CS-LE_220912_NozakiT_MS_Rac16_WT.RAW". data.sampleProcessingProtocol: <Crosslinking and Coimmunoprecipitation> Trophozoites of the amoeba transformants overexpressing HA-EhRacM or pEhEx-HA (mock control) were cultured in a 10-cm-diameter tissue culture dish with BIS medium under an anaerobic condition using Anaerocult® A. Trophozoites were detached from the surface of the dishes by adding cold PBS into the dishes and incubating them at 4℃ for 10 min. After three-time washing with PBS, the cell pellets were resuspended in 500 μl of 8 mg/ml dithiobis (succinimidyl propionate; DSP) solution and cross-linked. The mixture was incubated on the rotator (10 rpm) at RT for 30 min. To quench the reaction, 50 μl of 1 M Tris-HCl (pH 7.5) was added, and the mixture was further incubated as above for 15 min at RT. After the pellets were treated with DSP, they were washed with PBS twice. The cells were lysed with 1 mL of lysis buffer (50 mM Tris-HCl (pH 7.5), 150 µM NaCl, containing 1 % Triton X-100, 0.05 mg/ml E-64, and cOmplete™ Mini). After the debris was removed by centrifugation at 16,000 G at 4°C for 10 min, the lysates were mixed and incubated with 50 μl of protein G Sepharose beads at 4°C for 1 hr. After centrifugation at 800 G for 3 min at 4℃, the supernatant was mixed with 50 µL of anti-HA monoclonal antibody produced in mouse, clone HA-7, purified immunoglobulin conjugated to agarose beads and incubated with inversion at 4°C for 3.5 hr. The mixture was centrifuged at 800 G for 3 min at 4℃ to separate unbound proteins. The beads were washed three times with 1 ml of lysis buffer. After washing, the beads were resuspended with 180 μl of lysis buffer containing HA-peptide at the final concentration of 0.2 mg/ml. The mixture was incubated at 4°C overnight to elute the bound proteins for HA-EhRacM. After centrifugation at 800 G for 3 min at 4℃, the supernatant was collected and analyzed by Mass Spectrometry.  <Mass spectrometry (shotgun proteomics)> Protein extracts were rehydrated in 200 uL 10 mM TEAB and disulfide bonds reduced with 10 uL of 50 mM dithiothreitol for 1 hour at 60C. Samples were cooled to RT and pH adjusted to ~7.5, followed by alkylation with 10 uL of 100 mM iodoacetamide in the dark at RT for 15 minutes. Next, 100 ug (2 uL of 50 ug/uL) SP3 paramagnetic beads (GE Healthcare) were added to the samples, followed by 120 uL 100% ethanol. Samples were incubated at RT with shaking for 5 minutes. Following protein binding, beads were washed with 180 uL 80% ethanol three times. Proteins were digested on-bead with trypsin (Pierce) at 37C overnight (1 ug enzyme). Supernatant was removed from the beads and dried, followed by rehydration in 100 uL 0.1% trifluoroacetic acid. Peptides were cleaned by SPE on Oasis HLB micro-elution plate (Waters), dried, and rehydrated in 2% acetonitrile/0.1% formic acid prior to mass spectrometry analysis.
